arStrings.szText: {c_highlight}Surging Ruptures{/c} only appear in {icon:Marker_Helltide, 2.5} Helltide Zones. Achieve mastery for a rare chance to spawn a {c_highlight}Realmwalker{/c}.
A {c_highlight}Colossal Rupture{/c} occasionally appears in the {c_highlight}Fields of Desecration{/c} southeast of Zarbinzet and always spawns a {c_highlight}Realmwalker{/c} upon completion.
